# openwrt_network_wireguard_peer (Resource)

A WireGuard peer (`config wireguard_<interface>`).

Manages a `wireguard_<interface>` section in `/etc/config/network`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) WireGuard interface the peer belongs to (section type becomes `wireguard_<interface>`).
- `public_key` (String) Peer public key. (UCI option `public_key`.)
- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `allowed_ips` (List of String) Allowed IPs in CIDR notation. (UCI option `allowed_ips`.)
- `description` (String) Free-form description. (UCI option `description`.)
- `disabled` (Boolean) Disable the peer. (UCI option `disabled`.)
- `endpoint_host` (String) Peer endpoint host. (UCI option `endpoint_host`.)
- `endpoint_port` (Number) Peer endpoint port. (UCI option `endpoint_port`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `persistent_keepalive` (Number) Keepalive interval in seconds. (UCI option `persistent_keepalive`.)
- `preshared_key` (String, Sensitive) Optional preshared key. (UCI option `preshared_key`.)
- `preshared_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only variant of `preshared_key`: never stored in state or plan. Sent when `preshared_key_wo_version` changes. Requires Terraform/OpenTofu >= 1.11.
- `preshared_key_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send a new `preshared_key_wo`. Also changes when the router's value drifts from the last one sent.
- `route_allowed_ips` (Boolean) Create routes for allowed IPs. (UCI option `route_allowed_ips`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
